decisions.rationale: Post-viral keratitis is a broader term and does not specifically match the leaf disease.
Post-viral immune-mediated interstitial keratitis is not directly related to the leaf disease.

option_relations.rationale: Post-viral keratitis is a broader term and does not specifically match the leaf disease.
Post-viral immune-mediated interstitial keratitis is not directly related to the leaf disease.
Chikungunya virus–associated keratitis directly matches the leaf disease.
Chikungunya virus-induced bilateral stromal keratouveitis is a more specific condition that can be considered a subtype of Chikungunya virus–associated keratitis.
